description: Team Titrant unites pharmaceutical sciences, computational modeling, and environmental data analytics to solve agricultural challenges. Rooted in pharmacognosy and precision data science, we bridge orbital Earth observation with on-ground crop quality. For the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, we built PhytoSentinel—transforming live NASA satellite agroclimatology into actionable pre-harvest interventions that safeguard bioactive compounds, prevent spoilage, and protect high-value crops from climate stress.
